routes.label: Count the rows, then the seats

question: Each row of the Misty Moon Amphitheater has \(33\) seats. Rows \(12\) through \(22\) are reserved for a youth club. How many seats are reserved for this club?
solution:
Both rows \(12\) and \(22\) are included. Subtracting their numbers counts \(22-12=10\) steps between rows, so there is one more row than steps: \(11\) reserved rows. Each has \(33\) seats, giving
\[11\cdot33=\boxed{363}\text{ seats},\]
choice \(\text{C}\).
